name: Cursed Carnival
source:
Lights up at the Bloodmoon Circus! Here, monsters take center stage, and every smile hides a secret. Will your story be a romance… or a tragedy?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
血月马戏团亮灯了！在这里，怪物占据了舞台的中心，每一个微笑都隐藏着一个秘密。你的故事会是浪漫故事……还是悲剧？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
